name: Executive Briefing & Chief of Staff Ops
description: Prepares daily executive briefings with calendar conflict and commitment tracking, extracts structured action/decision packs from meeting transcripts, and synthesizes multi-signal stakeholder account dossiers.

skills.summary: Reconciles calendar events, priority threads, and open action items into time-boxed prep blocks with conflict and overdue alerts.
Extracts owner-assigned commitments, decision logs, unresolved blockers, and repeat carryovers from meeting transcripts.
Aggregates account ARR milestones, open escalations, executive touchpoints, and renewal countdowns into scored stakeholder dossiers.
